name: io.statiko/telegram
title: Statiko — Telegram trends & channel analytics
description: Live Telegram data: trending topics, channel profiles & metrics, post history incl. edits/deletions.

tools.name: get_trending_topics
tools.description: Ranked board of trending topics (stories) across tracked Telegram channels for a rolling 24h window. Each story carries a headline, context paragraph, member keywords, mention/channel counts, momentum and an hourly sparkline.

lang.description: ISO-639-1 language code of the board, defaulting to 'ru'. Boards are per-language; pick the language the audience posts in.

tools.name: get_trend_samples
tools.description: Sample Telegram posts that mention a trending topic, for reading what a story on the trending board is actually about.

norm.description: Normalized topic key of the story ('norm' field from get_trending_topics)

lang.description: ISO-639-1 language code of the board, defaulting to 'ru'. Boards are per-language; pick the language the audience posts in.

tools.name: search_channels
tools.description: Search Statiko's catalog of tracked Telegram channels by name and filter by verification, category, language and activity. Returns channel slugs to use with get_channels and get_channel_posts.

query.description: Channel name or username to match; omit to browse by filters

verified.description: true = verified channels only, false = unverified only

categories.description: Category slugs to filter by; a channel matching any one passes

languages.description: ISO-639-1 language codes to filter by (any match)

activity.description: Last-post activity buckets to filter by (any match)

tools.name: get_channels
tools.description: One channel: full profile of a tracked Telegram channel — description, subscriber and post counts, categories, AI insights, and metrics (subscriber growth, post frequency, view rate, engagement) with dated sparklines over an optional date range. Several channels (up to 25, ids and slugs mixed): compact comparison rows with headline metric values and changes over the last 30 days, from one lookup; unknown entries are listed as unresolved instead of failing the call.

channels.description: Channel slug (Telegram username, without the @) or numeric channel ids, mixed freely. One channel answers its full profile; several answer compact comparison rows.

start_date.description: Metrics window start (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); default -30d. Single channel only

end_date.description: Metrics window end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); default today. Single channel only

tools.name: get_channel_timeline
tools.description: Structural events in a channel's history: renames, description and photo changes, verification flips, subscriber/view milestones, and post edits or deletions — for telling what happened on a given date.

channel.description: Channel slug (Telegram username, without the @) or numeric channel id

event_types.description: Event types to keep; omit for all of them

order.description: Sort by event time: desc (newest first) or asc

tools.name: get_similar_channels
tools.description: Channels that resemble the given one by category and audience — the peer cohort to compare a channel's metrics against.

channel.description: Channel slug (Telegram username, without the @) or numeric channel id

tools.name: get_channel_posts
tools.description: Recent posts from a tracked Telegram channel, newest first, with text, view/forward/reply/reaction counts and `reactions_map`, the five most used reaction emoji with their counts. Accepts a channel slug or a numeric chat id, an optional text `query` to search the channel's posts, and an optional time range. Album posts are collapsed to one row, so a page may hold fewer than `limit` posts.

channel.description: Channel slug (Telegram username, without the @) or numeric channel id

query.description: Only posts whose text contains this term (case-insensitive substring)

since.description: Only posts at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp

until.description: Only posts before this ISO 8601 timestamp

message_type.description: Filter by message type: TEXT, PHOTO, VIDEO, AUDIO, DOCUMENT, UNSUPPORTED (case-insensitive)

tools.name: get_post_stats
tools.description: How a post's views, forwards, replies and reactions (total and per-emoji) evolved over its life, as a sparse series of snapshots bucketed per hour or per day, oldest first — for view velocity and reaction drift. `message_id` comes from get_channel_posts. A post with no recorded snapshots answers an empty series.

channel.description: Channel slug (Telegram username, without the @) or numeric channel id

since.description: Only snapshots taken at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp

until.description: Only snapshots taken before this ISO 8601 timestamp

bucket.description: Series resolution: one snapshot per hour (1h) or day (1d)

tools.name: get_collections
tools.description: Saved channel collections. No input: every collection of the organizations you belong to, plus the ones you starred. Pass ids (up to 25) to read specific collections, or source to list only one kind. Each row carries channel_ids in the collection's order — pass them to get_channels for profiles and metrics. An empty channel_ids means the collection is empty; don't call get_channels for it.

ids.description: Collection ids to read; yours or any public one. Omit to list your own

source.description: 'organization': only your organizations' collections; 'starred': only the ones you starred. Omit for both

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Statiko for tracked Telegram channels and currently trending stories. Returns document ids for the fetch tool; results cite statiko.io pages.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full document behind a search result id: a channel profile with metrics, or a trending story with context and sample posts.

id.description: Document id from a previous search: 'channel:<slug>' or 'trend:<window>:<lang>:<norm>'
